entry.title: Fractious Flow
entry.summary: A 32 inch spinning LED Art Piece built for SOAK 2024
entry.content:
Fractious Flow is a mesmerizing kinetic LED art piece inspired by the organic forms of sea urchins and the hypnotic patterns found in nature. This 32-inch spinning sculpture was created specifically for SOAK 2024, showcasing the intersection of technology and organic beauty.

The piece features hundreds of individually addressable LEDs arranged in a radial pattern that creates stunning POV (Persistence of Vision) effects when spinning. As the sculpture rotates, intricate patterns emerge and dissolve, creating a dynamic visual experience that changes with each rotation.

The design draws inspiration from the Fibonacci spiral and natural growth patterns, creating a sense of both mathematical precision and organic flow. The LED programming creates waves of light that cascade across the surface, mimicking the movement of water and the pulsing rhythm of marine life.

Medium: LEDs, Electronics, Steel Frame
Dimensions: 32" x 32" x 32"
Year: 2024
Location: SOAK 2024
Power: 12V DC, 50W

entry.title: Melty Cube
entry.summary: An interactive LED cube sculpture that responds to touch and movement
entry.content:
Melty Cube is an interactive LED art installation that explores the concept of digital decay and transformation. This geometric sculpture features a cube structure with LED strips that create flowing, organic patterns that seem to "melt" and reform in response to viewer interaction.

The piece incorporates proximity sensors and accelerometers that detect movement and touch, causing the LED patterns to shift and evolve in real-time. The visual effects simulate liquid metal or digital matter flowing through the rigid geometric structure, creating a fascinating contrast between the mathematical precision of the cube and the organic fluidity of the light patterns.

Each face of the cube displays different algorithmic patterns - some inspired by cellular automata, others by fluid dynamics simulations. The interactive elements allow viewers to become part of the artwork, their movements influencing the flow and intensity of the light patterns.

The installation explores themes of transformation, the intersection of digital and physical worlds, and the ephemeral nature of light and perception.

Medium: LEDs, Electronics, Acrylic, Sensors
Dimensions: 24" x 24" x 24"
Year: 2024
Interactive Elements: Proximity sensors, Accelerometer
Power: 24V DC, 100W

entry.title: Tetractys
entry.summary: A LED art piece based on the sacred geometric symbol of the Tetractys
entry.content:
Tetractys is a LED art installation inspired by the ancient Pythagorean symbol of the same name. The Tetractys, meaning "fourness," is a triangular figure consisting of ten points arranged in four rows, representing the fundamental principles of harmony and cosmic order in Pythagorean philosophy.

This piece translates the sacred geometry of the Tetractys into a three-dimensional LED sculpture, where each point of the original triangle becomes a glowing sphere. The LEDs are programmed to create flowing patterns that follow the mathematical relationships inherent in the Tetractys - the ratios of 1:2:3:4 that were considered fundamental to musical harmony and cosmic order.

The installation explores the intersection of ancient wisdom and modern technology, using contemporary LED art to illuminate timeless mathematical and philosophical concepts. The light patterns cycle through different sequences that correspond to musical intervals and harmonic ratios, creating a visual representation of the "music of the spheres" that the Pythagoreans believed governed the universe.

The piece invites viewers to contemplate the deep connections between mathematics, music, art, and the fundamental structure of reality itself.

Medium: LEDs, Electronics, Steel Frame, Glass Spheres
Dimensions: 36" x 36" x 18"
Year: 2024
Philosophical Inspiration: Pythagorean Tetractys
Programming: Harmonic ratio-based light sequences
Power: 12V DC, 75W
